chunks.text: We are a six vet mixed practice covering Kildare and West Wicklow. We cater for all your pet and farm animal needs in a relaxed and friendly environment. We offer a wide range of services for pets including both routine and emergency care, surgery, digital radiography and in house haematology and biochemistry blood testing. We also supply a nutrition advice service and are Hills and Royal Canin stockists of both prescription and non prescription diets.
Full general health check for your pet with of one of our experienced veterinary surgeons.
Wide range of services including routine neutering, radiography, blood testing, soft tissue surgery and dentals.
Free weight watchers clinic with our nurse Una. Also dietary advice for both healthy pets and pets with special dietary requirements eg diabetic or renal or liver disease.
Pain management for pets with chronic pain due to age related arthritis or secondary to disease or surgery.
We offer full vaccination programmes for dogs, cats and rabbits. We also have Rabies vaccinations as part of our Pet Passport Scheme.
We offer a free dental check with our nurse Una. When required we can perform routine cleaning and extractions for your pet.
